currentRevisionPcb.layoutStatus: UNKNOWN beyond corroborated outer assembly and major interfaces

screen.basis: Official 32.4 mm active circle, 240×240 pixels. Front cover projection, no photographic framebuffer.

inspectionGroups.notes: Separates the native optical stack for inspection only; +10 mm is a debug view, not an assembly spacing.

dimensionTargets.scope: Source CAD outline only; current Rev3 board dimensions unverified
Circular active area, not total glass
Lens outer diameter; folded flex excluded from diameter definition

materialBasis: Native CAD colors retained except optical stack darkened and LCD receptacles darkened using exact photographs. Missing source colors use neutral gray. Touch current-revision unknown PCB uses explicit neutral gray.
assemblyNotes: Native manufacturer assembly, unit millimetres, identity rigid transform. Parts omitted only where recorded; a live optical projection is a presentation overlay.
limitations: The retained STEP was authored on 2024-03-20 and remains linked by the current official resource page. That CAD date is not a product release date.
Native millimetres, source topology and assembly positions are preserved; no source geometry is scaled to fit a photograph.
USB orientation versus a particular factory firmware text direction has not been physically calibrated; the geometric view keeps native USB at negative Y.
No enclosure, battery or external cable is supplied by this model. RESET is visible geometry only; reset remains a platform action.
The live circular display is a 32.4 mm optical projection at the front cover plane, slightly offset to avoid coplanar rendering; it is not a manufactured laminate thickness.
Photographic registration is approximate and does not certify hidden dimensions or physical fit.

Current shop image explicitly reads Rev3 and the current schematic is Rev3. The 2024 CAD does not identify its PCB revision; only display stack, source board outline and photographed major connectors/buttons are retained. Omitted circuit details remain UNKNOWN.
The neutral board body is a 1.0 mm-thick reference from that CAD, not a measured current Rev3 layer stack. The visible UNKNOWN marking is a model provenance cue, not physical silkscreen.
Touch -B SKU26959 is a separately documented packaging option and is not represented by this base SKU25098 model.
